notes:
Quick summary:
- Contact: CTO (Amir Patel), Head of Product (Rita Gomez). Primary use: embeddings-backed semantic search for in-app knowledge and support routing. Mid-market PLG product; heavy nightly batch ingestion (1.2M docs/month) + low-latency query paths for top-tier customers.
- Evaluation path: started with Hosted API (fast onboard), completed embeddings POC -> moved to Dedicated sizing to hit throughput SLOs. Interested in Optimize recommendations for batching and quant profiles.
- POC details:
  * Hosted API POC (Jan-Feb): ingested 120k docs subset, tested embedding throughput via concurrent batch jobs (k = 128). Measured avg embed cost and wall-time.
  * Vector DB integration: two pilots run in parallel: Pinecone (managed) and Weaviate on k8s. Observed Pinecone tail-latency spikes at 95th pctl under load; Weaviate good medium-latency but maintenance ops heavier. Want Redwood guidance on recommended connector pattern and prefix caching.
  * Semantic search workload: mix of real-time query (50 qps peak for support customers) + daily reindex batches. Need deterministic cost per 1k queries and predictable cold-start latency.
- Performance targets / constraints:
  * 95th-pctl gen latency target: <250ms for short-context searches (<=512 tokens)
  * Embedding throughput: sustain 10k embeddings/min during nightly window without throttling
  * Cost sensitivity: unit cost optimization important; exploring batching + quantization suggestions from Redwood Optimize.
- Security / compliance: SSO (SAML) mandatory, SOC2 + audit logging required, KMS for customer keys, EU data residency for EMEA customers. Initial security checklist completed; one open item on key rotation policy.
- Commercials & pricing: prefer step-up model: Hosted for dev -> Dedicated reserved capacity for prod. Leadership asking for 12-month committed pricing and overage terms. We provided preliminary Dedicated sizing and monthly commit examples (see pricing deck).
- Quotes from calls:
  * Amir (CTO): "We need confidence Dedicated will remove the noisy-neighbor risk — predictable per-token economics is the lock."
  * Rita (Head Product): "If routing + vector connector is mature, switching from Pinecone-only is OK — but need operational handoff docs."
